author: opencode-worker-4
text: Diagnosis from worker-4 timeboxed round (2026-08-31, released unclaimed): (1) TX side is NOT the problem — rpl_ipv6_packet (util.rs:63-74) sets hop 255, DIOs carried Rule-255-uncompressed via send_ipv6_uncompressed_to (89cd460c0c: schc[0]=RULE_UNCOMPRESSED + wrap_schc_payload; capacity fine for ~70-byte DIOs under the elided/extended pre-checks). (2) RX admission: ca236263fa added ipv6[7]!=255 rejection in AuthenticatedPeerSchcContext (codec.rs:~1806) — test DIOs do carry 255, so the rejection likely fires EARLIER or DIFFERENTLY. (3) KEY BLOCKER for the fixer: RplStack::process_received (receive.rs:223) maps EVERY decompress error to RxError::SchcDecompress and receive.rs:232-238 converts claims_rpl-but-invalid packets to RplRejected — the actual SchcError (which admission leg failed: peer context, permit, role, dst, hop, signature freshness) is swallowed. FIRST STEP: temporarily log/propagate the real error in decompress_authenticated_frame (stack.rs:293) or assert matches! on it in one failing test. (4) Hypothesis to check first: the rpl_stack loopback tests provision peers via add_peer (LinkLayer PeerIdentity) but the Rule-255 DIO admission path now requires AuthenticatedPeerSchcContext/permit evidence (accepts_with_authority / accepts_current + inbound_rule) which the test provisioning never mints — i.e. the tests need the same authenticated-peer provisioning the codec vector harness uses (authenticated_dio_vectors.rs receive_dio_with_hop_limit construction). (5) Affects all 6 tests uniformly => single provisioning/admission seam, not 6 individual bugs.
